name: Damodar

source.name: Chota Nagpur Plateau, near Tori village

sink.name: Confluence with the Hooghly
sink.location: Near Falta, South 24 Parganas district, West Bengal

did_you_know: The Damodar Valley Corporation (1948), India's first multipurpose river valley project, was explicitly modeled on the United States' Tennessee Valley Authority.
The Damodar valley holds some of India's richest coalfields, historically earning the river the nickname 'River of Sorrow' for its pre-dam flooding.
